India's real GDP growth went from -5.8% in FY21 to 9.7% in FY22, then 7.6%, 9.2% and 6.5% in FY25. The FY21 dip was the Covid year, and the later numbers are the rebound and then a gradual cooling. These are from memory of the official revised figures, so they may be slightly off. I can't check live data from here, and the latest year may have been revised again.
